description: This plugin runs inside Indigo's embedded Python (3.13 in Indigo 2025.2 and 2026.1), not an interpreter we choose. Strict constraint filtering makes Renovate offer only PyPI releases whose requires-python accepts 3.13. Raise the constraint by hand when Perceptive Automation ships a new Python with Indigo (same reasoning as indigo-mcp-server's CI-Python rule).

packageRules.description: Keep the Python constraint above fixed. Renovate tracks `constraints.python` as a tool-constraint dependency and would otherwise propose moving it to the newest Python, which defeats its purpose. Raise it by hand when Indigo ships a new Python.
